jackson.tool: read-only javap bytecode metadata; no fixture loading/build/test execution
jackson.mutable_container_copy: ObjectNode.deepCopy new ObjectNode iterates original entries and invokes each child.deepCopy; ArrayNode.deepCopy new ArrayNode iterates original elements invoking each deepCopy. No old container references are reused. Standard new containers allocate own children Map/List. Bytecode excerpts retained, no fixture/class initialization.
jackson.immutable_leaf_copy: ValueNode.deepCopy returns this. Allowed exact scalar classes contain final primitive/String/BigInteger/BigDecimal values; String and numeric value types immutable. NullNode singleton has no mutable instance payload. Exclude BinaryNode/POJONode/MissingNode and every subclass. This proof does not cover arbitrary custom maps/nodes or concurrent caller semantics; privately copied standard tree used throughout actual route.
jackson.ordering: ObjectNode copy inserts entries in original iteration order; ArrayNode preserves list order. Token additionally checks exact serialized representation and JSON equality; root/framework parsing/hashes unchanged.
